name: meta_suggest
retrieval: the requesting user's own private question history and feedback for the opted-in meetings; never another user's
citation: Every suggestion lists the IDs of the private turns it is based on.
abstention: With too few turns to show a repeated pattern, recommend no change

termination.on_limit: further tool calls are denied; answer from evidence already retrieved or abstain

task_steps: Find needs that repeat across turns, not single unsatisfying answers.
Decide per need: save a wording preference, adjust an existing skill, or propose a new skill.
For a new skill, write a specification and test cases a developer can implement. Change nothing.
